test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
​​​Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ee2b8fed1a3eaeada2d9fe9b7f393e045825c06e831272ad00d2e777c914887.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: SO – NJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a6269474809415ec80b4b2c11b0be46e39f5177e23bdefe2e74adfd5e4300ee.png] 

Option 2: TP – OK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e5101d92eff218e89fd0980f77f6a97ffa4ac996ecd8c3338818d55eef45e83.png] 

Option 3: NJ – HG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3505b5dc123d2be8389e2768ef3cdafe820463bbab28c0c2717a5b55a9f1c82d.png] 

Option 4: JF – EA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37422a7d93269c829faa3823576df2069d5ee71f0217c05be3273a42bf92b379.png] 

Thus, NJ – HG is different from the rest given options.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 3.**
